messages:
Jordan Park: Quick kickoff for the Marketplace Live partner session on June 21. Format: 30m product demo + 25m panel + 5m wrap. Need speaker confirmations, demo redundancy, and booth swag handoff.
Priya Singh: Confirmed partners: Nebula and AcmeCloud. Keiko + Lisa available. Keiko wants a 60s provisioning demo; Lisa wants ~90s model-import flow.
Liam O'Connor: Runtime standby required. @Ravi can you own the failover play and do a dry-run? :eyes:
Ravi Patel: Yep. Plan B = 2m pre-recorded clip + local laptop fallback using a 4-bit quantized runtime. I'll produce a 10-step preflight checklist and run it 15m before show.
Sandra (Partners Ops): Partner asks for co-branded enamel pins and 4 dev kits at the booth. Need HS codes + declared values for customs. Who provides commercial invoice?
Tomas (Logistics): Ops can generate invoice if we get a final item list + values by Jun 7. QuickCouriers preferred for on-site handoff; will confirm pickup window.
Priya Singh: Sheet: https://short.link/marketplace-booth — add recipient name, phone, courier tracking, and customs HS code column. Please populate ASAP.
Keiko (Nebula Systems): We'll send read-only demo creds and a 60s provisioning script to Jordan via 1Password today.
Lisa (AcmeCloud): Providing a marketplace demo account and sanitized dataset. Slides + short script to be shared by May 31. Mask customer names in screenshots.
Maya (Solutions): Legal check — need consent for recording reuse and co-host attribution. Looping in LegalBot.
LegalBot: Reminder: use partner release checkbox on speaker form. Co-hosted replay OK with standard attribution; no extra licensing fees.
Jordan Park: Proposed tech rehearsal Jun 19, 10:00am PT. Block 75 minutes for AV check, demo run, and failover drill. I'll send invites once we confirm leads.
Ravi Patel: Runbook snippet (drop into shared doc):
```
- 00:00 host intro + housekeeping
- 05:00 Keiko (Nebula) provisioning demo — 60s
- 11:00 Lisa (AcmeCloud) model import walkthrough — 90s
- 18:00 buffer + brief panel setup
- 20:00 moderated panel begins
- 45:00 audience Q&A
- 58:00 wrap + CTA
```
Sandra (Partners Ops): Tomas — I'll DM you the booth receiver name and signature contact. Ops will prepare commercial invoice once Ravi confirms declared values.
Tomas (Logistics): On it. I'll confirm courier (QuickCouriers) and upload tracking numbers to the sheet by Jun 10.
Priya Singh: Outstanding items due May 29: final slides, demo creds in 1Password, declared customs values, rehearsal RSVP. I'll compile checklist and ping owners.
Jordan Park: Great work. I'll post the runbook link in #partners-docs, send calendar invites, and follow up on customs/invoice. If anyone needs to add talk tracks, drop them in the doc. :rocket:
